programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Between the world we see and the things we fear…There are doors. When they are opened...Nightmares become reality. These are the true stories of the innocent and the unimaginable.

programme.title: Paranormal Contact
programme.sub-title: Grey Lady of Stoney Beach Part 1
programme.desc: Jeff DeEll, Adam Myles, and Kelly Klassen explore haunted locations along Canada’s east coast, seeking contact with the dead and uncovering the hidden stories that linger in the shadows. Guided by intuition, research, and firsthand encounters, they venture deep into the unknown to give a voice to the spirits still waiting to be heard.

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: A young woman finds her Tempe, AZ apartment burglarized and her roommate missing. Police suspect foul play, but quickly exhaust every lead. Desperate for answers, the victim's father consults psychic Gale St. John, who leads police to the girl's body - and warns that the killer will strike the roommate next. On a rural road in Louisiana, a motorist discovers the mangled body of a 16-year-old boy. Police first believe it's a hit and run - but then suspect murder. They call on psychic Rosemarie Kerr to help them find the truth - but the truth is almost too much to bear.

programme.title: Is It Haunted?
programme.desc: Everybody has that question, does life after death really exist? We have all lay there in bed at night in the pitch-black Thinking I feel like I am being watched?….are we being watched? Perhaps? This is something that our team knows well, we look for evidence to suggest that spirits exist. They exist, but they exist on a level that surrounds everything we do in life. We have questions that we know have answers, we are searching in those shadows, we walk in the darkness where people won’t go, knowing only too well that given the right circumstances and timing something or someone will answer that question.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show
programme.sub-title: The Rise of the Fourth Reich (Nazi's in America)
programme.desc: The Allies defeated the Axis Powers on the battlefield, but did they actually win the war? Richard interviews several alternative historians who say that while the German Army may have surrendered in 1945, the Nazi's never officially did. Further, these researchers claim that dozens of high ranking Nazi scientists, intelligence officers and generals were exfiltrated into the United States through Operation Paper Clip where they were placed in powerful and highly influential positions atop the US power structure. Finally, these researchers/historians claim, these Nazi's and their descendants continue to exercise considerable influence on world events to the present day.

programme.title: Virginia Paranormal Case Files
programme.desc: The team at Virginia Paranormal Investigations travels the state investigating claims of paranormal activity and compiling the Virginia Paranormal Case Files. The show offers a balanced look at paranormal investigation. VAPI has a reputation for being honest and approaching each case with an open mind. The evidence is real, the people are real, and the reports are real.
